exclude_from_strategy.YM: Duplicate Dow exposure; retain the predeclared older ZD identity.

input_policy: Predeclared raw identities from the audited historical universe: ND over EN, SP over ES/SC, ZD over YM; EC excluded. Monthly returns use only sufficiently fresh observed endpoint closes. No full-panel cleaning, empirical duplicate selection, averaging, retrospective supplied-monthly reconstruction or RL/ER fallback. Missing held returns fail. These repaired development rules do not reproduce archived zero-filled results or create fresh out-of-sample evidence.
